name: com.repliohq/site
title: Replio (restaurant reviews)
description: Replio (repliohq.com) for restaurants: price quotes, review reply drafts, complaint patterns, docs.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Every public repliohq.com page that has a markdown copy: path, title, one-line description, canonical URL and last-updated date.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One repliohq.com page as markdown, by path (for example "/pricing" or "/learn"). Use list_pages or search_pages to find paths.

path.description: Site path such as "/pricing". A full repliohq.com URL also works.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Keyword search across every repliohq.com page (titles, descriptions and full text). Returns the best matches with a snippet each.

query.description: Words to look for, such as "Rex text plan price".

tools.name: quote_price
tools.description: The exact Replio price for a number of locations: monthly total, yearly total, billing terms, and whether checkout is self-serve. Same rate the pricing page charges.

locations.description: How many locations (stores) the business runs.

tools.name: draft_review_reply
tools.description: A short, restrained first draft of a public reply to one food or drink review, for a person to edit and post. Rule-based, not a model, and not the drafts inside the Replio product. Reviews that mention allergy or illness get a take-it-private reply. The review text is not stored.

review.description: The review text, up to 2,000 characters. Leave out names and contact details.

tools.name: find_complaint_patterns
tools.description: Counts which complaint themes (such as wait time, order accuracy, food temperature, staff, cleanliness) recur across 20 to 200 food or drink reviews. Keyword rules, not a model; a count of mentions, not proof of a cause. The review text is not stored.

reviews.description: Review texts, one per item, 20 to 200 distinct reviews. Leave out names and contact details.
